note: Missouri River bottomland wetland area west of Forest City, managed for waterfowl. The primitive camping area is a small gravel loop under shade trees at the area headquarters on the north side of the wetland pools, off Inlet Road. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - one mapped primitive camping area, a gravel loop at the area headquarters (the stored pin) - free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the 8/25/2022 map shows one Primitive Camping symbol at the Area Headquarters beside a privy and parking lot, at the north edge of the Lowell Mohler wetland unit. GIS point 276 (39.97834,-95.24821 = stored pin) sits on a small gravel loop (~40 m across, shade trees) with gravel lot 3223 at its east end; reached on the area's gravel improved road from CR 290/Inlet Road - no ford. A 23-ft rig fits the loop.

SEASON CONTEXT (no change; season is manual): the map's restrictions show the Waterfowl Hunting Only Zone (Oct. 15 through the end of North Zone duck season) and a Waterfowl Refuge (Oct. 15 - March 1) on the pools just south of the camping loop; the page: 'non-hunters are prohibited from the waterfowl hunting zone during waterfowl hunting season'. The camping loop itself is outside the hatched zones on the map. Stored season note left as is.
PIN: stored 39.97834,-95.24821 = GIS camping point on the loop - fine.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - a seasonal wetland pool ~60 m NW across grass; the Missouri River is ~1.5 km away.
PHONE: (816) 271-3100 on the area page matches.
